```{r setup, include = FALSE}

library(tidyverse)

```

```{r data}
airbnb <- read_csv("https://bit.ly/3oadz2L", show_col_types = FALSE)
```


## Analysis

```{r listings-plot, wrap = "right", wrap.width = 0.45, fig.width = 4, fig.height = 2.8}
airbnb |>
  count(address, room_type) |>
  ggplot(aes(x = n, y = reorder(address, n, sum), fill = room_type)) +
  geom_col() +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = comma) +
  labs(x = "Listings", y = NULL, fill = NULL, title = "Listings by city and room type") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 11) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom", plot.title.position = "plot")
```

```{r price-table}
airbnb |>
  group_by(City = address) |>
  summarise(
    Listings = n(),
    `Entire home (%)` = round(100 * mean(room_type == "Entire home/apt")),
    `Median nightly price ($)` = median(price, na.rm = TRUE)
  ) |>
  arrange(desc(Listings)) |>
  kable(format.args = list(big.mark = ","), caption = "Listings and prices by city")
```
